name: chimpvibe
description: Resolve ChimpVibe tags to install or inspect exact builds, and contribute to admitted native games or start independent games through private Drafts. Follow the live MCP guide; the owner alone reviews and publishes.

settings.name: ChimpVibe member token
settings.description: The token you minted at https://chimpvibe.dev/join (shown once). It is yours alone; it never leaves your machine except as the Authorization header to chimpvibe.dev. Gemini CLI asks for it during install and stores it in the system keychain.
